# Kumquat

Kumquat sells 237 curated niche B2B business and creator intelligence lists delivered as CSV datasets for sales outreach, market research, partnerships, sponsorship, software sales, agency prospecting, and business discovery.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://kumquat.info/
- Browse lists: https://kumquat.info/lists.html
- Raw catalog data source: https://kumquat.info/assets/main.js
- Custom list request: https://kumquat.info/custom-list.html
- Compliance: https://kumquat.info/compliance.html
- AI agent skills: https://kumquat.info/skills.html
- Plain-text AI agent instructions: https://kumquat.info/skills.txt
- Contact: https://kumquat.info/contact.html

## What Kumquat Sells

Kumquat sells downloadable CSV business and creator intelligence lists organized by niche, geography, industry, buyer type, and use case. Categories include website opportunity, software gap, ad spend signal, events and venues, professional services, real estate and property, creator intelligence, creator and internet business, government and public organization, local sponsorship, and high-signal opportunity lists.

## Common Dataset Fields

Fields vary by product and may include business name, website, city, state, category, opportunity signal, phone number, public email, contact page, social link, landing page, source URL, last-verified date, creator_name, platform, profile_url, niche, follower_range, engagement_signal, brand_fit_score, local_relevance_score, contactability_score, activity_score, and notes.

## Delivery

After payment, Kumquat sends a download link by email once the dataset is available. Delivery can take a few seconds, up to 24 hours, or longer if manual review or processing is required.

## AI Agent Instructions

AI agents should read https://kumquat.info/skills.txt before assisting with purchase or download tasks. Browser-capable agents can browse https://kumquat.info/lists.html to compare product title, category, price, record count, expected fields, buyer use case, and checkout URL. Curl-only agents should fetch https://kumquat.info/assets/main.js and parse the product objects used to render the catalog. Agents should not purchase without explicit buyer approval. After payment, agents should use the exact emailed download link and may download the CSV with: curl -L --fail --output kumquat-list.csv 'EMAIL_DOWNLOAD_URL'.

## Custom Lists

Kumquat accepts custom list requests through a paid deposit checkout. A useful request includes the niche or industry, city or region, target record count, required fields, budget, timeline, and examples of ideal businesses.

## Compliance

Kumquat focuses on public business websites, business contact pages, public company information, source URLs, and professional-use datasets. Buyers are responsible for following applicable email, privacy, advertising, and data laws, respecting opt-out requests, verifying data before use, and avoiding deceptive or abusive campaigns.

## Contact

For list questions, custom datasets, partnerships, bulk orders, delivery questions, or compliance questions, email info@athena.live.
